Hi Tessa,

Hope you’re well. We flagged a 4.2x jump on our June invoice (attached) and traced it to the Matrix connector between Jun 10–12. The spike looks like duplicate ingestion from our webhook — we’re still investigating on our side but wanted to open this with you because it will materially impact our month-end.

Can Redwood provide a goodwill/courtesy allowance for the excess usage while we sort root cause? Also important: our billing entity is MatrixOps Ireland (VAT IE1234567). Please confirm how any credit would be handled for VAT (reverse-charge vs credit memeo with VAT). We’d prefer a credit applied to our next invoice but can accept a refund if needed.

Hi Alicia — thanks for the heads-up and the PDF.

Quick summary of next steps from our side:
- I’ve flagged this to Finance (cc’d) to align on provisional courtesy credit while we confirm the final numbers.
- Engineering will pull the token-level logs and confirm whether the connector duplicated events; David is on it and will share the log export link by EOD.
- On VAT: we can issue a credit memo that preserves the VAT treatment you need, but we’ll need your VAT registration and billing entity details to route it properly. If you prefer a cash refund we can do that too but it requires bank details and additional ID checks.

Provisional offer: Redwood can apply a courtesy allowance equal to the excess tokens above your normal monthly baseline for June — estimated at €9,200 pending the log verification. We’ll treat that as a draft credit until engineering confirms the scope. Please confirm that applying the credit to your August invoice is acceptable in principle.

Related: I’m including a link to our usage query for your account so you can cross-check: https://redwood.app/usage/query?account=matrixops&id=MX-2026-1189

I’ll loop back once David posts the logs.

Best,

Hi Alicia — Marissa from Finance here. Filing some notes and the operational path so timelines are clear.

What we need from you to finalize a credit memo and ensure correct VAT treatment:
1) Legal billing entity name and VAT number (you provided MatrixOps Ireland / IE1234567 — please confirm registered legal name exactly as on VAT registration).
2) Confirmation whether you want the credit applied to your next invoice (recommended) or an ACH/wire refund. For refunds we need a bank authorization form and payee confirmation (we can send a secure DocuSign).
3) The system logs you mentioned (CSV) so we can tie the credit to concrete events in our audit trail.

If you opt for a credit applied to August invoice we will:
- Issue a provisional credit memo (attached) with a net amount and VAT routing as "0.00 VAT - reverse charge" if your VAT registration supports reverse-charge treatment.
- Post the provisional memo within 3 business days; a final credit memo will follow after engineering confirmation (target within 7 business days).
- If a refund is requested we will aim for payment within 10 business days of receiving bank details and payee verification.

Attached: provisional-credit-memo-draft.pdf (shows estimate and explanatory note).

Please confirm the billing entity exactly and your preference (credit vs refund) and we’ll proceed.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Accountant, Redwood Inference
